description: Elixir is a language that runs on the Erlang runtime. It is used for apps that handle many small tasks. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.
versionNote: Examples use Elixir 1.14 or later on the Erlang runtime.
whatYouWillLearn: Keep a small group with Elixir
Pull values from a shape with Elixir
learningObjectives: Use an anonymous function with Elixir
